description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git's diff and patch functionalities with various pathspec patterns. It includes setup commands, test cases, and expected output validations involving Git commands like git diff-index and git diff-tree, with focus on pathspec filters and submodule handling.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a provided command or set of commands.

methods.name: compare_diff_raw
methods.description: Compares raw diff output against expected.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Asserts that the output is empty.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock in Git testing.
